title: Record the source value copied into register 258
body:
## Summary
- Immediately before event 20719, register 262 holds `-1` when register 359 starts at `1`. The data register contributes `0`.
- The addition multiplies that value by `1` and writes `-1` into register 258, which is `0` until then.
- One earlier addition, event 16152, writes that `-1`. No selected frontier change and no new exponent.
